name: Occupancy-tuned launch square
description: An elementwise integer-square kernel launched two ways -- a hand-picked fixed block size vs. a cudaOccupancyMaxPotentialBlockSize-driven configuration -- isolating occupancy-driven automatic launch configuration.
output_description: CUDA executable writes numeric output to output/cuda_output.txt.

performance.notes: Runtime logs are written by tools/benchmark_case.py.

extraction_notes: square reproduced verbatim from NVIDIA/cuda-samples simpleOccupancy.cu. Host driver (both manual and cudaOccupancyMaxPotentialBlockSize-driven launches), gen_array, CMakeLists, and Python oracle are new. Snapshot sk-10.
notes: Real-extraction occupancy-API case from collection snapshot sk-10. arrayCount=1048576, array[i]=(i%1000)^2. Exact integer oracle (max value 998001).
